newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices steady at reduced levels.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices steady at reduced levels.

text.p: Indian cotton prices held steady at reduced levels on Wednesday with fresh inquiries halting an earlier slide, dealers said.
In spot deals Bengal Desi was quiet at 790/830 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw ginned was steady at 1,355/1600 rupees.
Gujarat Sankar 4 (long staple) was steady at 16,500/17,500 rupees per candy (355.56 kg) for the average variety and at 18,000/18,500 rupees for the superior type.
